problem:
Problem description
- There is a weekly planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}$$, indexed by $$t\in\mathcal{T}$$, and a set of fabric types $$\mathcal{P}$$, indexed by $$p\in\mathcal{P}$$.
- The factory operates over $$S$$ shifts per week, but the planning is based on the total weekly available production time.
- Each product $$p$$ has a production rate $$r_p$$ measured in meters per hour.
- Each product $$p$$ has a minimum required sellable quantity in each period, denoted by $$d^{\min}_{p,t}$$.
- Each product $$p$$ has a unit profit $$\pi_p$$ per meter, which is part of the business data.
- The factory has regular production capacity $$H_t^{\mathrm{reg}}$$ in each period and an overtime allowance limited by $$H_t^{\mathrm{ot,max}}$$.
- The planning goal is to determine how much of each fabric type to produce and sell, together with how much overtime to use, so that all minimum sales requirements are satisfied, regular production time is fully utilized, overtime stays within the allowed limit, and overtime is minimized as much as possible.
- The production plan is assumed to be weekly and product-specific, with no mention of inventory carryover, backlogging, or product substitution beyond the stated minimum sales requirements.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{p,t}$$: the quantity of product $$p$$ produced and sold in period $$t$$, measured in meters.
  - $$z_t^{\mathrm{reg}}$$: the amount of regular production time used in period $$t$$, measured in hours.
  - $$o_t$$: the overtime used in period $$t$$, measured in hours.
  - $$\eta$$: the overall objective value representing total overtime or its penalty score.

Input Format
{
  "num_products": "Integer $$P$$, the number of fabric types in $$\\mathcal{P}$$.",
  "num_periods": "Integer $$T$$, the number of planning periods in $$\\mathcal{T}$$.",
  "num_shifts": "Integer $$S$$, the number of shifts per week.",
  "regular_hours": "Length-$$T$$ array with entries $$H_t^{\\mathrm{reg}}$$, the regular production hours available in each period.",
  "max_overtime_hours": "Length-$$T$$ array with entries $$H_t^{\\mathrm{ot,max}}$$, the maximum overtime hours allowed in each period.",
  "production_rate": "Length-$$P$$ array with entries $$r_p$$, the production rate of product $$p$$ in meters per hour.",
  "minimum_sales_demand": "Matrix of size $$P\\times T$$ with entries $$d^{\\min}_{p,t}$$, the minimum sellable quantity required for product $$p$$ in period $$t$$, in meters.",
  "unit_profit": "Length-$$P$$ array with entries $$\\pi_p$$, the profit per meter of product $$p$$.",
  "overtime_penalty": "Optional scalar $$c^{\\mathrm{ot}}$$, the penalty per overtime hour if overtime is evaluated in cost terms.",
  "planning_priority": "Ordered list of planning priorities, namely full utilization of regular time, overtime limit compliance, minimum sales satisfaction, and overtime minimization."
}

Output Format
{
  "objective_value": "Scalar $$\\eta$$, the minimized overtime amount or overtime penalty value.",
  "period_plan": [
    {
      "period": "$$t$$",
      "regular_hours_used": "$$z_t^{\\mathrm{reg}}$$",
      "overtime_hours_used": "$$o_t$$",
      "product_plan": [
        {
          "product": "$$p$$",
          "quantity_meters": "$$x_{p,t}$$"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "num_products": 2,
  "num_periods": 1,
  "num_shifts": 2,
  "regular_hours": [110],
  "max_overtime_hours": [10],
  "production_rate": [1000, 1000],
  "minimum_sales_demand": [
    [70000],
    [45000]
  ],
  "unit_profit": [2.5, 1.5]
}

parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of fabric types in the planning set \(\mathcal{P}\)

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the horizon \(\mathcal{T}\)

parameters.name: regular_hours
parameters.description: Regular production hours available in each period

parameters.name: max_overtime_hours
parameters.description: Maximum overtime hours allowed in each period

parameters.name: production_rate
parameters.description: Production rate of each fabric type in meters per hour

parameters.name: minimum_sales_demand
parameters.description: Minimum required sellable quantity for each product in each period

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit per meter for each product

parameters.name: overtime_penalty
parameters.description: Optional overtime penalty per overtime hour

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product produced and sold in each period, in meters

variables.name: regular_hours_used
variables.description: Regular production time used in each period, in hours

variables.name: overtime_used
variables.description: Overtime used in each period, in hours

variables.name: objective_value
variables.description: Overall objective value representing total overtime or its penalty score

constraints.name: production_quantity_nonnegative
constraints.description: Production quantity must be nonnegative for every product and period.

constraints.name: regular_hours_used_nonnegative
constraints.description: Regular production hours used must be nonnegative in every period.

constraints.name: overtime_used_nonnegative
constraints.description: Overtime used must be nonnegative in every period.

constraints.name: minimum_sales_satisfaction
constraints.description: Each product-period production quantity must satisfy the minimum sellable quantity requirement.

constraints.name: regular_time_full_utilization
constraints.description: Regular production time is fully utilized in each period.

constraints.name: overtime_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Overtime used in each period must not exceed the available overtime allowance.

constraints.name: production_time_balance
constraints.description: Total production time consumed by all products in a period equals the sum of regular time used and overtime used.

constraints.name: objective_value_link
constraints.description: Link the objective-value variable to total overtime across all periods.

constraints.name: period_sales_equals_production
constraints.description: Since there is no inventory carryover, backlogging, or substitution, sales in each period are exactly equal to production in that period; this is already captured by the production quantity variable.

objectives.name: overtime_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total overtime used across all planning periods, or the equivalent overtime penalty score if an overtime penalty parameter is used.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total overtime used across all planning periods; the objective value variable \(\eta\) is linked to this total overtime. The overtime penalty parameter is not used because the stated planning priority is direct overtime minimization.
